ei.title: A Brief Biography of Edward O. Wilson
ei.subject: 올림포스전국연합고1_2026

fullPassage: Edward O. Wilson was born in Birmingham, Alabama, in 1929. In his early childhood, he became interested in nature and spent much time in the outdoors. At age seven, he was partially blinded in a fishing accident; his reduced sight led Wilson to the study of ants. He could not observe larger animals from a distance. Instead, he concentrated on smaller creatures he could study up close. After studying evolutionary biology at the University of Alabama, Wilson transferred to Harvard University, where he became a professor in 1956. He never received a Nobel Prize — the prize didn't recognize research in the field of evolutionary biology. However, he was awarded the Crafoord Prize in 1990. Wilson, known to some as the "modern-day Darwin", died at the age of 92 in Massachusetts.

det.analysis:
✅ ① interested — smaller — transferred: 자연에 '관심을 갖게(interested)' 되었고, 가까이서 연구할 수 있는 '더 작은(smaller)' 생물에 집중했으며, 하버드로 '옮겼다(transferred)'는 원문과 일치 ←정답
❌ ② bored: '지루한(bored)'은 interested와 반대
❌ ③ bigger: '더 큰(bigger)'은 smaller와 반대 (그는 큰 동물을 관찰할 수 없었음)
❌ ④ remained: '머물렀다(remained)'는 transferred(옮겼다)와 반대
det.tip: interested ↔ bored, smaller ↔ bigger, transferred ↔ remained

det.korean: study → studying: 전치사 After 뒤에는 동명사(-ing)
det.analysis: 전치사 After 뒤에 명사 역할의 동명사(V-ing)가 와야 한다. After studying = 공부한 후에. study(동사원형) → studying(동명사)
det.tip: After + V-ing(동명사) = ~한 후에

questions.passage: Edward O. Wilson was born in Birmingham, Alabama, in 1929. In his early childhood, he became interested in nature and spent much time in the outdoors. At age seven, he was partially blinded in a fishing accident; his reduced sight led Wilson to the study of ants. He __________ larger animals from a distance. Instead, he concentrated on smaller creatures he could study up close. After studying evolutionary biology at the University of Alabama, Wilson transferred to Harvard University, where he became a professor in 1956. He never received a Nobel Prize — the prize didn't recognize research in the field of evolutionary biology. However, he was awarded the Crafoord Prize in 1990. Wilson, known to some as the "modern-day Darwin", died at the age of 92 in Massachusetts.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: could not observe=관찰할 수 없었다 — 멀리 있는 큰 동물을 볼 수 없었음
det.analysis:
✅ ① could not observe: 시력 저하로 멀리 있는 큰 동물을 '관찰할 수 없었다(could not observe)'는 맥락. 뒤의 '대신 작은 생물에 집중했다'와 연결 ←정답
❌ ② was eager to catch: '잡고 싶어 했다'는 모순
❌ ③ preferred to study: '연구를 선호했다'는 '~할 수 없었다'는 흐름과 다름
❌ ④ continued to raise: '계속 길렀다'는 무관
det.tip: could not observe larger animals from a distance = 멀리서 큰 동물을 관찰할 수 없었다

After studying evolutionary biology at the University of Alabama, Wilson transferred to Harvard University, where he became a professor in 1956. questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: led Wilson to=Wilson을 ~로 이끌었다 — 저하된 시력이 개미 연구로 이어짐
det.analysis:
✅ ② led Wilson to: '그의 저하된 시력이 Wilson을 개미 연구로 이끌었다(led Wilson to the study of ants)'는 맥락에 적절 ←정답

❌ ① kept him from: '~하지 못하게 했다'는 부정적 의미로 흐름과 반대

❌ ③ prevented him from: '~하지 못하게 막았다'는 흐름과 반대

❌ ④ discouraged him from: '~하지 못하게 단념시켰다'는 흐름과 반대
det.tip: lead A to B = A를 B로 이끌다 (led Wilson to the study)
